properties.name: pgredis.dialect
properties.description: SQL dialect: auto (detect from the connection), postgresql, or mysql.

properties.name: pgredis.table-prefix
properties.description: Prefix applied to every backing table (mr_kv, mr_counter, mr_zset, mr_events).

properties.name: pgredis.initialize-on-startup
properties.description: Create tables and indexes on bean startup.

properties.name: pgredis.ttl-check-on-read
properties.description: Re-check expire_at on every read and treat an expired row as absent.

properties.name: pgredis.ttl-sweep-seconds
properties.description: Interval for the background sweeper deleting expired rows. 0 disables it.

properties.name: pgredis.pub-sub-poll-ms
properties.description: Poll interval for table-based pub/sub (dialects without native pub/sub).
